help.title: HOW TO PLAY
help.tip: 💡 Stuck? Follow the yellow arrow and the tip at the bottom of the screen. Your progress saves automatically.
help.move.d: Drag anywhere on the screen (WASD or arrows on a computer).
help.chop.d: Walk next to a tree. The wood stacks up on your back.
help.build.d: Dashed squares show a price in 🪵 wood or 💵 cash. Stand on one to pay, bit by bit.
help.fight.d: Bears attack in waves. Stand close to hit them automatically. Towers shoot them for you.
help.sell.d: Bring meat to the SELL TABLE, then grab the 💵 cash pile next to it. Spare wood (not needed for building or repairs) sells for $1: stand still at the table.
help.grill.d: Raw meat sells for $5. Grill it first: a steak sells for $12.
help.workers.d: Hire a lumberjack, a hunter and a cashier to run the camp for you. They carry 30% of what your bag holds, so upgrading your bag upgrades them too.
help.upgrades.d: Endless levels. AXE hits harder each level (+1.5 damage) and makes your towers and walls stronger. BAG carries more and makes selling faster.
help.campfire.d: Heals you fast and cures poison. Once you're fully healed, it goes pale and recharges for 5 seconds.
help.walls.d: Close all 4 sides (gates north and south). Bears chew on walls: repair them with wood on their REPAIR square.
help.expansion.d: Behind the south wall: lay the foundations (wood), then expand the camp (cash). The annex has its own walls, 2 more workers, a SMOKEHOUSE (2× faster, $36 smoked meat) and 2 more tower spots.
help.bosses.d: A boss comes every 3 waves and drops a bag of cash. Later they come in pairs.
help.armored.d: Arrows bounce off. Break its plates with your axe, then bring the plates to the ARMOR square to forge your own armor.
help.poison.d: Its bite poisons you until you die, unless you reach the campfire, which cures it. Step back when it dies. It drops a poison vial.
help.thrower.d: It breaks your walls from afar: go out and hit it. Repair walls with wood on their REPAIR square.
help.ballista.d: The log thrower drops heartwood. Heartwood + 20 wood + $250 turns an arrow tower into a ballista: 12 m reach, 9× arrow damage, bolts that crack armor. Bears and thrown logs can destroy it: it drops its heartwood back so you can rebuild.
help.bolts.d: A poison vial + 15 wood + $150 gives a ballista poison bolts: bears it hits lose 2 hp per second for 5 seconds.
tip.campfire: Poisoned! It won't stop until you reach the campfire: run!
tip.cloud: The poison bear is about to burst: step back!
tip.bossArmored: ARMORED BEAR: arrows bounce off. Break its plates with your axe!
tip.bossThrower: LOG THROWER: it smashes your walls from afar. Go out and hit it!
tip.bossPoison: POISON BEAR: its bite poisons you, and it bursts when it dies
tip.bossKing: BEAR KING: break his ice armor with the axe. Red ring = ground slam: step out!
tip.loot: Boss loot! Walk over the bag to grab the cash
tip.forge: Bring armor plates to the ARMOR square: armor soaks up hits
tip.toxic: Toxic meat is worth $0 raw. Grill it into a $30 spicy steak!
tip.toxicNoGrill: Toxic meat is worth $0 raw. Build the GRILL to cook it for $30
tip.ballista: Heartwood! Bring it + 20 wood + $250 to an arrow tower: BALLISTA (12 m, 9× arrow damage)
tip.poisonBolts: Poison vial! Bring it + 15 wood + $150 to a ballista: POISON BOLTS
tip.vialKeep: Keep this poison vial: it will give a ballista poison bolts
tip.fireRecharge: The campfire is recharging: it heals again in a few seconds
tip.smoker: The SMOKEHOUSE cooks twice as fast: smoked meat sells for ${price}
tip.repairBroken: {wall} is broken! Bring wood to its REPAIR square
tip.repairDamaged: {wall} is damaged! Bring wood to its REPAIR square
tip.fight: Bears! Stay close to hit them. Low HP? Run back under your towers.
tip.chop: Walk next to a tree to chop it
tip.cash: Pick up your cash next to the sell table
tip.grill: Put raw meat on the GRILL: steaks sell for $12 instead of $5
tip.grillTake: Grab the cooked steaks from the grill
tip.sell: Sell your meat at the SELL TABLE
tip.buy: You can buy: {name}. Stand on its square
tip.woodpile: Grab wood from your wood storage
tip.spareWood: Spare wood? Stand still at the SELL TABLE to sell it for $1 each
tip.hunt: Hunt bears for meat and sell it to afford the {name}
tip.complete: Your camp is complete! Survive the waves.
